title: Choose SKYMART's visual world
question: Choose the shopping world that should define SKYMART, or re-roll for a fresh hand.

options.label: Aerial Carousel
options.lineage: airport baggage carousel meets precision retail display
options.thesis: Products arrive on a calm aluminum runway, making discovery feel continuous rather than crowded.
options.viewport: A looping product runway crosses the first viewport while search, category gates, price, and add-to-cart controls dock directly to each arriving product.
options.risk: The transport metaphor can feel impersonal unless product imagery and Thai copy carry warmth.

raised.raise: Every product stop owns one decision-critical truth and state changes remain immediately legible.
Scale shifts create real pacing instead of repeating one product-card size.
Filters and product results remain traceable as one synchronized selection system.
The mobile layout transforms structurally rather than merely shrinking the desktop composition.

options.label: Product Theatre
options.lineage: museum design shop and precision product launch
options.thesis: Every item receives a deliberate stage, while supporting products form a quiet, curated index.
options.viewport: One useful object is demonstrated at life scale beside a compact buying rail, with the next category entering from below as an exhibition index.
options.risk: This is the most familiar premium-retail direction and can understate SKYMART's marketplace breadth.

options.label: Market Hoarding
options.lineage: screenprinted Bangkok street-fair flyer pinned over a calm ticket panel
options.thesis: Marketplace abundance becomes a layered city of products, disciplined by one clean shopping finder.
options.viewport: A full-bleed product collage carries the categories while a single white finder ticket handles search, filters, and the first buy action.
options.case: It identifies strongly with lively regional commerce, but loses some of the calm product clarity promised by SKYMART.
options.risk: Energy can become visual noise if the collage exceeds one dominant gesture.

options.label: Night Instrument Market
options.thesis: Six luminous product gauges turn shopping facts into a ritual cross-check.
options.viewport: Six ranked product instruments expose price, rating, stock, delivery, seller, and fit before purchase.
options.case: The facts are exceptionally clear, but mainstream shoppers would read the cockpit before the marketplace.
options.kept: One truth per stop and calm, explicit state transitions.
options.risk: The dark technical world narrows broad-market appeal.

options.label: Pixel Market
options.thesis: Products become addressable tiles in a luminous marketplace playfield.
options.viewport: A whole-tile catalog makes each selection and cart state visibly discrete.
options.case: Its interaction is memorable, but the game language reduces trust for general purchasing.
options.kept: A strict motion and rarity palette prevents decorative state noise.
options.risk: The visual language overpowers product photography and premium intent.

options.label: Bolted Market Book
options.thesis: Each category becomes a typographic collision on a mechanically hinged spread.
options.viewport: Two hinged pages stage products at radically different scales with purchase actions embedded in the printed rhythm.
options.case: The pacing is powerful, but angled typography compromises scanability for repeated shopping tasks.
options.kept: Meaningful scale shifts keep the storefront from becoming an equal-card grid.
options.risk: Thai copy at aggressive angles would become tiring on mobile.

options.label: Woven Catalog
options.lineage: jacquard brocade woven from punched instructions
options.thesis: Every filter choice weaves the visible product field into a new coherent motif.
options.viewport: A synchronized filter ledger and product weave reveal how every selection changes the catalog.
options.case: The mechanism maps beautifully to filtering, but the textile identity is too category-specific for general commerce.
options.kept: Filters and results behave as one traceable system.
options.risk: Dense pattern competes with unrelated product categories.

options.label: Tension Market
options.lineage: tensegrity column of carbon rods and red cord
options.thesis: Products, filters, and cart form one visible network of choices and counterweights.
options.viewport: A structural product network expands and resolves around the shopper's selected needs.
options.case: It expresses connected decisions, but shopping products feel secondary to the structural diagram.
options.kept: Compact screens receive a true structural transformation, not a squeezed desktop layout.
options.risk: Leader lines and force notation read as engineering software.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar marketplace layout executed with exceptional spacing, typography, and product photography.
canonCard.viewport: A promotional hero, category shortcuts, and a responsive product grid with clear search and cart actions.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately usable but intentionally indistinguishable from established marketplace conventions.
